entities.name: Edwin Graf von Rothkirch und Trach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edwin Graf Rothkirch und Trach born in Militsch, was a German general during World War II who commanded Army Group Centre Rear Area and later an army corps. As a show jumper, he took part in the 1932 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
